tiers.candidate: evidence exists (file, capture, probe or owner note); recipes may bind it, labelled
tiers.accepted: owner or child evidence, or a binding owner rule

strengths.strength: The child can never lose: no fail states, and doing nothing wins nothing
strengths.reuse: Every recipe keeps it; a recipe step that could fail the child is rejected

strengths.strength: Touching the world changes it truthfully and visibly (dirt clears where the child scrubs)
evidence: commit f2140465 (fixture dirt clears along the scrub path)
strengths.reuse: Every activity recipe names the visible change each touch makes

strengths.strength: Picture-first interface a non-reader can use
strengths.reuse: UI in any new content follows the Storybook UI tokens

strengths.strength: Roshan has a written acting profile that keeps her motion consistent
strengths.reuse: Every new character gets a movement profile before animation

strengths.strength: Story clips between scenes carry the plot without replacing a child action
strengths.reuse: Day One only until the owner extends it

strengths.strength: Identity locks make a character reproducible
strengths.reuse: Every recurring character gets an identity sheet in this format

strengths.strength: The real family voices and the book art make the game personal
strengths.reuse: Protected; never altered or imitated; new lines use the approved synthetic voices

strengths.strength: Reuse-first prototypes reach a playable state the same day
evidence: design/FAIRY_RESTORATION_PROTOTYPE_2026-09-30.md (zero new art, chapter brief followed, combined CI green the same day)
strengths.reuse: Recipes start from an asset shortlist before any generation

strengths.strength: Owner questions numbered with a default get one-line answers
evidence: owner answers of 2026-09-30 to Q12-Q16 in docs/handoffs/codex_visual_design_language_2026-09-30/README.md
strengths.reuse: Every cycle asks at most five numbered questions with defaults

strengths.strength: A lesson that becomes a rule, a tool and a card stays learned
strengths.reuse: Every lesson names its write-back target

strengths.strength: Reviews that invalidate themselves when their source changes
strengths.reuse: Strengths and exemplars expire when their evidence changes

strengths.strength: Acts shaped Teach / Play / Twist / Bow, with every beat a different verb

strengths.strength: Silly humour and an imp who can lose or win and restart instantly delight the owner

strengths.strength: Companions who follow Roshan (Baby Eagle, the rainbow dust bunny) and stuffed animals matter to the family
strengths.reuse: The companion recipe and the grow lane favour them
